name: Letter Trek
summary: Hop on board the Letter Trek bus for fun and frolicking word games for 1-4 players. Whether flying solo or playing with your pals, Letter Trek is an accessible, playful, brain-teasing trip for the whole family. Head to the beach to play Sandy Stacks! Your task is to build a tower of words that climbs into the sky - the higher you go, the higher your score! Dig up letters, golden shells and wildcards from the sand, and challenge your companions - or yourself - to form the highest scoring words in a crossword-style grid. Stop by the canyon for Lightning Letters! Connect jumbled letters to create as many words as you can before the timer runs out. Watch for the new lightning letter appearing midway through the match. Use it quickly before it changes! Grab your phones and take a ride with the Letter Trek gang today!
